results.title: (PDF) Explainability and Interpretability in Deep Learning Models
results.content: Explainability and Interpretability in Deep Learning The rise of deep learning has revolutionized many fields,yet the complex ity of these models often leads to challenges in ex plainability and interpretability.As deep learning systems are increasingly deployed in critical applications—such as healthcare,finance,and autonomous vehicles—understanding their decision-making processes becomes paramount.This paper explores the concepts of explainability and interpretability,differentiating between the two and discussing their significance in fostering t rust and accountability in AI systems.We review various techniques for enhancing model transparency,including feature importance analysis, visualization methods,and surrogate models.Additionally,we assess the trade-offs between model performance and interpretability,highlighting case studies that illustrate successful implementations of interpretable deep learning.The findings underscore the necessity of integrating explainability into the development lifecycle of AI systems,advocating for a multidisciplinary approach that encompasses technical,ethical,and regulatory perspectives. results.title: An Explainable AI Paradigm for Alzheimer’s Diagnosis Using Deep Transfer Learning
results.content: In this study, we propose an explainable AI (XAI)-based approach for the diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease, leveraging the power of deep transfer learning and ensemble modeling. The proposed framework aims to enhance the interpretability of deep learning models by incorporating XAI techniques, allowing clinicians to understand the decision-making process and providing valuable insights into disease diagnosis. Our findings showcase the potential of combining deep transfer learning with explainable AI in the realm of Alzheimer’s disease diagnosis, paving the way for more interpretable and clinically relevant AI models in healthcare. **Keywords:** Alzheimer’s disease, transfer learning, explainable AI (XAI), saliency maps, grad-CAM. Interpretability Using XAI Methods: The integration of saliency maps and grad-CAM in the proposed model enhances its interpretability and transparency in Alzheimer’s diagnosis. results.title: Ensemble-based Convolutional Neural Networks for brain tumor classification in MRI: Enhancing accuracy and interpretability using explainable AI - ScienceDirect
results.content: # Ensemble-based Convolutional Neural Networks for brain tumor classification in MRI: Enhancing accuracy and interpretability using explainable AI. Ensemble of VGG16, DenseNet121, Inception-ResNet-v2 improves MRI classification. Grad-CAM++ highlights key MRI regions, aiding model interpretability in diagnosis. Accurate and efficient classification of brain tumors, including gliomas, meningiomas, and pituitary adenomas, is critical for early diagnosis and treatment planning. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a key diagnostic tool, and deep learning models have shown promise in automating tumor classification. This study explores the use of transfer learning with pre-trained architectures, including VGG16, DenseNet121, and Inception-ResNet-v2, to classify brain tumors from MRI images. The ensemble model outperformed individual Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architectures, achieving an accuracy of 86.17% in distinguishing gliomas, meningiomas, pituitary adenomas, and benign cases. The proposed ensemble-based deep learning framework improves the accuracy and interpretability of brain tumor classification from MRI images. By combining multiple CNN architectures and integrating explainability methods, this approach offers a more reliable and transparent diagnostic tool to support medical professionals in clinical decision-making.

results.title: Unlocking the Black Box: Advancements in Explainable AI and Model Interpretability - IARJSET
results.content: ## International Advanced Research Journal in Science, Engineering and Technology. ### Unlocking the Black Box: Advancements in Explainable AI and Model Interpretability. **Abstract:** Explainable AI (XAI) is a rapidly advancing area within artificial intelligence, dedicated to enhancing the transparency and interpretability of AI models. This paper delves into the significance of interpretability in AI, emphasizing how explainability fosters trust, accountability, and compliance with regulatory standards. Various techniques, including feature attribution, model distillation, and local interpretable model-agnostic explanations (LIME), are reviewed as tools to render AI decisions clearer and more reliable. This paper illustrates how XAI can bridge the divide between machine learning predictions and actionable insights, paving the way for AI systems that are both trustworthy and accountable. **Keywords:** Explainable AI (XAI), Interpretability, Transparency, Model distillation, Feature attribution, Local interpretable model-agnostic explanations (LIME), Trust in AI, Accountability, Regulatory compliance, Ethical AI. *International Advanced Research Journal in Science, Engineering and Technology (IARJSET)*,.
